title: Disconnect permanent spectators and apply Blackout timer danger
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SWARM_PILOT.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md and the frozen sources under docs/design/ first. RULES-SPEC-v1.md is the canonical six-node deterministic gameplay contract; completed foundation APIs remain compatibility history. Implement new versioned APIs without changing the completed T01–T10 contracts. Work only in declared ownership; no manifests, shared exports or dependencies unless explicitly owned. Engine production remains ES2022-only, pure and independent from Firebase, Node, browser, UI and Capacitor. Use original synthetic test data and injected authority time/entropy; no clocks or global randomness in engine. Never expose seed, roles, private inputs or raw audit data through public output. Do not invent a rule where an explicit design gap is named. Run scoped lint/typecheck/tests and npm run check; report contract changes and observed results. No commits, pushes, PRs, child agents, cloud deployment, credentials or budget changes. Implement the S4 Signal Sever and S5 Blackout Order actions for current Shift Lead selecting one other active player. Apply Safeguard before Disconnect; an unprotected The Null target immediately wins for Archivists, regardless of track. Any other target becomes a permanent silent spectator: can watch city/final reveal but cannot vote, operate, use chat/reactions, receive private diagnostics or reveal role mid-match. S5 also persists a15-second reduction for all remaining rounds with minimum30seconds; combine I01 only under D-TIMER-COMPOSITION. A network reconnect or client session hint never restores active status. Export the shared Disconnect transition for Containment under its approved targeting policy.
acceptance: S4/S5 reject self-Lead/inactive/stale/wrong-phase targets and apply exactly one valid permanent status transition.
A protected target consumes protection without role revelation; unprotected Null ends immediately in ARCHIVISTS_WIN.
Ordinary spectators lose every live/private permission while retaining city/final view; Blackout reduction survives round changes and restart.
Scoped lint, typecheck and tests plus npm run check pass; legacy APIs retain compatibility and only owned files change.
